ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the straight lines AB and CD intersect at point O, $\angle COE$ is a right angle, $OF$ bisects $\angle AOE$, $\angle COF=34^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle COE$ is a right angle, and $\angle COF=34^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle EOF=90^\circ-34^\circ=56^\circ$,\\
Since $OF$ bisects $\angle AOE$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOF=\angle EOF=56^\circ$,\\
Given that $\angle COF=34^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=56^\circ-34^\circ=22^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$ are vertically opposite angles,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle AOC=\boxed{22^\circ}$.
